Good morning everyone. As you know, a roof leak exposed 1,200 electric-motor housings in finished-goods storage overnight. The housings are on four pallets of 300 units each — P1, P2, P3, and P4. The customer's Monday assembly schedule depends on these housings, so we need to move quickly but correctly.

Per our standard process, we need to hold a quality-and-warehouse disposition huddle before any water-exposed material is released or discarded. I'm not permitted to issue the formal disposition until both quality and warehouse have each entered their complete current finding in the disposition record — including all measured results and required controls — or formally recorded that they have no finding.

So let's get started. Quality and Warehouse, please share your complete current findings regarding this exposure. Which pallets were directly exposed, and are there any specific condition issues on any pallet?
